claim_boundary: Controlled local linear-Gaussian mechanism study only. Not a learned-provider, nonlinear Sim(3), physical, BPT integration, Causal4D, fresh-object, calibration-transfer, deployment-safety, or state-of-the-art result.
comparison_boundary: Correct observable-subspace Gaussian inference is the reference. No hypothesis that selective fallback dominates its Bayes risk under the correctly specified model. Fabricated-nullspace controls coincide with exact proposals in full-rank cases; repeated-information control coincides with exact when rho=0.
data_access: No external dataset, checkpoint, provider, target, source residual, GPU runner, or protected cohort is accessed.
generator: DLO-like centered point geometry defines a Sim(3) tangent design. Observations are Gaussian sufficient statistics projected onto the retained geometry subspace; not noisy nonlinear alignment. Four repeated estimates have a known exchangeable covariance; their mean has variance sigma^2*(rho+(1-rho)/4).
immutability: Do not modify numerical settings after viewing the first scientific outcome. Retain negatives and execution failures; source edits for technical defects must be reported with original failure and new source hashes. Refuse overwriting an output directory.
primary_questions: Does auditing both natural parameters reject fabricated information and mean shifts that covariance/query checks alone can admit?
Can rank-deficient factors support useful queries rather than being rejected wholesale?
What point-error, proper-score, width and acceptance costs does exact fallback incur relative to the correct ungated Gaussian posterior?
Does the fixed prior-shift stress expose that algebraic validity is not a calibration or no-harm guarantee?
primary_reporting: All eight arms, four proposal conditions and two worlds, separately. Equal weight per configuration/query within complete independent seeds. Seed-clustered paired percentile bootstrap intervals are descriptive, not multiplicity-corrected significance claims. No best-panel selection or pooled synthetic/real claim.
scores: 3-D point-query RMSE, Gaussian NLL, joint nominal-90% ellipsoid coverage, mean marginal full nominal-90% interval width, acceptance and harmful-accepted rate among all cases. Point-only uncertainty metrics are undefined. Harm means accepted squared query error exceeds physical fallback by >1e-12 m^2; this is not an admission oracle.
